paper.title_en: Carrollian CFTs and the Light Front
paper.abstract_en: Carrollian symmetries play an important role in building holographic duals to asymptotically flat spacetimes (AFS). This construction hinges on the isomorphism between the (asymptotic) isometries of AFS and the conformal Carroll algebra. Carroll symmetries also naturally arise on the lightfront, as co-dimension one subalgebras in the Poincare algebra written in lightcone coordinates. In this paper, building on the isomorphism between four dimensional (4d) Poincare and 3d conformal Carroll algebras, we make a connection between physics on the lightfront and Carrollian CFTs. Using insights from the lightfront literature, we construct new representations of Carroll CFTs that connect to massive bulk scattering. We compute two-point functions and build a map between 3d Carroll CFTs and 4d lightfront theories living in AFS.

decision.abstract_zh: Carrollian 对称性在构建渐近平坦时空（AFS）的全息对偶中起着重要作用。这一构造依赖于 AFS 的（渐近）等距变换与共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构。Carroll 对称性也自然地出现在光前上，作为用光锥坐标写出的 Poincaré 代数中的余维一子代数。本文基于四维（4d）Poincaré 代数与 3d 共形 Carroll 代数之间的同构，把光前上的物理与 Carrollian CFT 联系起来。利用光前文献中的洞见，我们构造了与有质量体散射相联系的新型 Carroll CFT 表示。我们计算了两点函数，并建立了 3d Carroll CFT 与存在于 AFS 中的 4d 光前理论之间的映射。
